reviews.comment: They simply changed the name to cover up all the bad reviews from before, but the food is still just as terrible. The food isn’t fresh, there’s hardly anything worth eating, and the prices are actually even more expensive now.

reviewReply.comment: Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts with us. Our ingredients are freshly purchased. We are truly sorry that our food did not live up to your expectations. We take your feedback about food quality and pricing very seriously and will work closely with our kitchen team to make improvements. Should you be willing to give us another chance, you are welcome to come back with your original receipt to get 10% off your meal. Thank you again for your valuable feedback.
